summary: RAG corpus-select topology + champion LoRA v2a_e1
hypothesis: Crossing the ragCorpusSelect in-context topology (from exp020) onto the champion LoRA adapter v2a_e1 should combine the best retrieval strategy with the best fine-tuned weights, yielding a quality above either alone.
technique: A matrix sweep crossing the ragCorpusSelect inference topology (RAG-based exemplar retrieval + in-context generation, raw from exp020) with the champion LoRA adapter v2a_e1, evaluated greedy on the full-30 set — a systematic all-inference × best-LoRA cross product.
result: Scored 0.238 on the full-30 greedy gate — above the raw exp020 baseline (0.195) but far below the champion exp056 (0.440). The RAG topology did not benefit from the LoRA adapter as hoped; discarded.
